intro: We hold a recorded total fee for {{count}} published MBA / PGDM colleges in India. This guide puts the top MBA colleges in India with fees for 2026 in one place, so you can see what a programme costs before you shortlist it.
The colleges at the top follow our verified 2026 MBA ranking. After them, colleges are ordered by recorded total fee, lowest first.
listLead: The first ten cards are ranked colleges with a recorded fee. Each card shows the college's main full-time programme where we hold its fee, so check the programme name before you compare.
snapshot: Across the {{feeN}} published colleges on this list, the median recorded total fee is {{feeMedian}}. The middle half of colleges sits between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.
A low figure is worth a second look. Check whether it covers the full two years or only the first year.
Most colleges here are private ({{private}}), with {{public}} public institutes. Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Haryana have the most listings.
firstCollegesLead: At IIT Delhi, IIT Bombay and IIFT we only hold an executive or short-course fee, so those figures are not the cost of the full-time MBA.
Placement figures are the latest year in our records from 2020 onwards. A dash means we do not hold that figure yet.

compare.heading: How to compare the top MBA colleges in India with fees
paragraphs: Start with the programme, not the number. A two-year full-time MBA and a one-year executive course are not priced the same way.
Then check these points on the official fee notice:
bullets: Whether the fee is for the full programme or one year, and whether hostel, mess and laptop charges are included.
Whether the college awards an MBA (a university degree) or a PGDM (an AICTE-approved diploma). The award is different, so check which one you are paying for.
The entrance test used for the latest cycle (CAT, XAT, MAT, CMAT, NMAT, SNAP or a state test) and the cut-off for your category.
The most recent official placement report. Use our placement figures as a reference year, not a promise.

faqs.question: How many MBA colleges in India have fees listed here?
faqs.answer: {{count}} published MBA / PGDM colleges have a recorded total fee in our records. The list only covers colleges with a fee on file, so the full number of MBA colleges in India is higher.

faqs.question: What is the typical MBA fee in India in 2026?
faqs.answer: Among the {{feeN}} published colleges here, the median recorded total fee is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half falls between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}. Top-ranked full-time programmes cost much more: in our records, IIM Ahmedabad's MBA Finance total is ₹26.50 lakh and SPJIMR's official PGDM fee for Indian participants is ₹24.86 lakh, including basic hostel.

faqs.question: Why does a top college show a low fee on its card?
faqs.answer: The Department of Management Studies at IIT Delhi is listed with the full-time MBA tuition of ₹12 lakh. Read the programme name on each card, and confirm the current fee on the official site.

faqs.question: Why are IIM Bangalore and IIM Calcutta missing from this fee list?
faqs.answer: They are in our 2026 MBA ranking, but we do not hold a total fee for them yet, so they cannot be placed in a fee list. You can still find them on the best MBA colleges in India page.

faqs.question: Are the placement figures guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No. They are the latest placement year in our records for each programme, and they change with every batch and recruiter mix. Confirm them in the college's latest official placement report.
